marketing.company.members.jenn.body: Jenn Harper знает, что значит создавать то, что действительно важно. С запуска Cheekbone в 2016 году основательница бренда красоты из народа анишинаабе не растёт в одиночку: она поддерживает коренную молодёжь, направляя 2% прибыли Cheekbone напрямую на эту работу, и бросает вызов отраслевым стандартам с помощью продуктов без жестокости к животным и с меньшими отходами.
marketing.company.members.jenn.name: Jenn Harper
marketing.company.members.pierre.body: Подпитываемый эмпанадами (его любимым полуденным перекусом), живой вокал Pierre и захватывающие биты унесли наших мастеров далеко-далеко. Рождённый в Демократической Республике Конго, Pierre поёт и читает рэп на лингала, французском, английском, тшилуба и kikongo. Его узнаваемое звучание принесло внимание шорт-листа Juno и номинацию. Он также сооснователь Bimber — культового международного музыкального сериала из Монреаля, который проходит каждый месяц в субботу, ближайшую к полнолунию.
marketing.company.members.pierre.imageAl: Портрет Pierre во время музыкального выступления
marketing.company.members.pierre.name: Pierre
marketing.company.members.sasha.body: Недавно нам доставило абсолютное удовольствие поговорить с человеком, которого не нужно представлять: с блестящей Sasha Velour. Sasha присоединилась к нашим мастерам на час через Zoom, чтобы поговорить о творчестве, бизнесе и queer-идентичности. Её мысли — трогательные и заставляющие задуматься — опирались на творчество всей жизни и закулисный взгляд на drag.

marketing.partnerships.projects.callisto: In a 6-week sprint, we generated an organic social campaign and created an AR Filter for Instagram—teasing story arcs, characters, and weapon upgrades with shocking visuals and cryptic copy.

Digital Kitchen created the Live Action Trailer combining live-action and VFX to unravel the spine-chilling Black Iron Prison. Partnering with Prettybird director Vellas and Rodeo FX, filmed in Brazil and Los Angeles.
Fans joined our SMS partnership with Community for customized teasers, first looks at weapon closeups, and an AR filter placing fans face-to-face with one of Callisto's horrific biophage worms.

The Callisto Protocol is the first title from Striking Distance Studios. Its creator Glen Schofield co-wrote Dead Space—one of the best horror games of all time. The stakes were high between audiences who had never heard of it and fans with bullish expectations.
The horror and beauty of Callisto's setting spoke for itself—all it needed was a strong platform, delivered in time for two major holidays.
marketing.partnerships.projects.canadien: OG1's branding was based on Montréal-born brands, organizations and cultural figures—with the Canadiens conspicuously absent. On Thanksgiving weekend, 50 influencers were invited to a secret event at the Montreal Pool Room.
One week later, OG1 was revealed as The Original One on the ice of the home opener. 20,000 roaring fans rallied together, and the launch video was broadcast to the entire country.
18 million impressions sparkled on socials. We can't wait for the next chapter of Canada's oldest team and its fresh connection to a dynamic city like no other.

The Montreal Canadiens are the oldest professional hockey team in Canadian history—their creation precedes the NHL itself. Gen Z has an entirely fresh orientation to sports, so we decided to tell a different story: individuality, self-expression, and originality. The story of a city.
OG1 resonated with all generations through a story of individuality, self-expression, and originality in every sense of the word.
The Montreal Canadiens — The Original One
marketing.partnerships.projects.cheekbon: Leaders from Grassy Narrows, Neskantaga, and Cowichan Tribes collected real water samples processed into 50 tubes, packaged into premium boxes designed by our artisans.
For Indigenous History Month, influencers and politicians received polluted lip glosses. Sephora Canada featured the sets, hitting 36 million organic impressions on social media.
Would you put this to your lips?
Every dollar of Cheekbone's Sephora sales in June 2022 went to Water First. Glossed Over raised over $45,000, training over 400 Indigenous youth as certified water treatment plant operators.

More than 100 Indigenous communities in Canada don't have access to clean drinking water. Sid Lee collaborated with Cheekbone Beauty to create Glossed Over—a lip gloss collection of contaminated water sourced from Indigenous communities.
Glossed Over enabled Canadians to experience the realities of people in Indigenous communities who don't have a choice.
marketing.partnerships.projects.hogwarts: We reignited Harry Potter fandom culture by engaging with memes, hosting trending topics, and crafting captivating assets—potion, spell, and beast demonstrations, an Unauthorized Guide to Hogwarts, and more.
Calling fans to live the unwritten
A dynamic social campaign that evolved with fans—listening to conversations to provide the exact snippets of content they wanted most, keeping the magic alive at State of Play and Gamescom.

The real honor was playing a significant role in one of the most substantial culture events in the 2023 gaming landscape—building connection with fans and sending them off to their first day at school.

The Harry Potter universe has between 200 and 300 million fans. When WB Games Avalanche announced the most ambitious Harry Potter game in history, it called for an extraordinary launch strategy. Dreams were at stake.
We grew infectious excitement and ultimately sent fans off to their first day at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry.
marketing.partnerships.projects.linkbuds: Sony Linkbuds are hollow, like a donut—a portal to seamlessly blend listening to music and interacting with surrounding environments. We created an immersive film with VFX and intricate sound design, branded with #Neveroff.
Performance for Gen Z audiences increased across all social channels. A TikTok brand lift study called the film "outstanding", citing significant lift in Ad recall.
The hashtag went viral on TikTok with 21 billion views, making it the audio industry's most famous HTC. Strong client relationship + trust to get bold = big results.

When Sony broke their own alphanumeric naming rule with the launch of Linkbuds, we heard the ambition to innovate loud and clear. We worked with Sony to shake their traditional product launch mold and align with Gen Z's playful spirit.
We set the bar for Sony's new product launches where it belongs: way up high.
marketing.partnerships.projects.loto.det: By 2025, Loto-Québec's mobile app was set for a new chapter. The mandate: design Quebec's first unified gaming app combining weekly lottery play with casino games in a single, seamless experience.
Lottery is a ritual built on habit and anticipation. Casino play is exploratory. The strategy bridged both behaviours in one app, honouring patterns while connecting the two worlds.
In March 2025, Quebecers could check weekly numbers, scan tickets, and jump straight into slots or table games—all without leaving the app.
Play It All in One Place

Every week, millions of Quebecers open the Loto-Québec app to check their lottery numbers. When it came time to play casino games, they had to switch to the website—a split experience that didn't make sense.
For Loto-Québec, the new app represents a huge step forward in bringing all offerings into a single, trusted platform.
marketing.partnerships.projects.resortsW: GLOW's 5 shows run day and night on RWLV's 100,000 square foot exterior display, mirrored by a globe-like screen in the lobby—five joyfully psychedelic short films paying tribute to Vegas surrealism and glamour.
Each show employs distinct art styles—from an interdimensional 2D cat explorer to a motion-captured dance love story—each matched with an original cinematic soundtrack.
"Neon Space" is a psychedelic journey into space featuring an animated feline named Cheddar. GLOW recently took home Platinum at the MUSE awards in the Experiential & Immersive category.
Digital Kitchen's GLOW is a collection of 5 shows designed to turn heads on the Las Vegas strip. Resorts World Las Vegas features some of the largest screens in North America.
Each night RWLV joins the chorus with GLOW—a stunning burst of psychedelic colour and form on the most visually competitive space on earth.

marketing.partnerships.projects.rona.det: When looking for a "tackeuse," a "zigouilleur," or a "tempo," users couldn't find products without knowing exact technical terms. We closed the gap by embracing local slang.
We built a custom search engine understanding everyday language, integrating over 225 regional terms through data analysis, field research, and technical integration.
5.3M organic impressions, +125% website traffic, and 22K new website searches—proving RONA understands the reality of the people who use its tools.
For RONA, a brand deeply rooted in Quebec, connecting with customers meant embracing the way they actually talk about renovation—not just technical product terms.
The DIYctionary sparked conversation across Quebec and proved that the best experiences are the ones that are authentic.
marketing.partnerships.projects.gillesVi: What if the brand itself became a living tribute to Gilles' extraordinary journey? We imagined a platform where fans and newcomers could connect with the spirit of Gilles Villeneuve.
A signature logo echoing Gilles' handwriting, an interactive timeline, an e-commerce website, and official merchandise—each piece designed to honor his raw skills and instinct.
New social channels take his legacy beyond the website, turning history into conversation and inviting younger, global audiences to discover Gilles.
Gilles Villeneuve was more than a driver; he was a cultural icon. The Villeneuve family's ambition was to reclaim ownership of the complete story and ensure his legacy inspires a new generation.
Sid Lee transformed a revered legacy into a living brand experience, empowering a new generation of fans to keep the legend's spirit racing forward.
marketing.partnerships.projects.toughCoo: Children draw their favorite foods; tattoo artists translate them into temporary tattoos that come alive through augmented reality. The approach raised $450,000 in its first year, proof that co-creation with young survivors can drive both engagement and fundraising.

The second year introduced a mobile game where tattoos unlocked playable characters across four taste-themed levels. Over 20,000 players cleared more than 4,000 levels, and arcade versions were installed in hospitals.
Building a Video Game in Six Weeks

Across four editions, Tough Cookies raised more than $1.7 million while engaging over 80,000 players—transforming charitable giving into family play rather than competing with expensive merchandise or celebrity appeals.

Over four years, the Tough Cookies campaign has raised $1.7 million for the Fondation Charles-Bruneau through IGA stores across Quebec. Every year, kids who have beaten cancer create characters that become temporary tattoos sold at checkout—unlocking AR adventures, mobile games, and interactive stories.
Tough Cookies replaced abstract research funding with personal stories families can see and touch—kids who are alive, healthy, and contributing their creativity.
marketing.partnerships.projects.igaAvata: During Montreal Canadiens home games, the Bell Centre lights up with a guessing game on the 8K jumbotron—a 3D avatar slowly takes shape in IGA's signature animated style.
IGA's AI pipeline keeps the brand's style intact while opening new ways to tell human stories at any scale.
Training a Model on IGA's Visual Signature
Sid Lee built a custom AI pipeline, training a diffusion model on IGA's visual archive to generate avatars that look authentically "IGA" at stadium scale.
Artists refined every portrait—proportions adjusted, lighting balanced, materials polished—until everything hit broadcast-quality standards on a 60-foot screen.
Ten avatars delivered in a fraction of traditional 3D time. The pipeline lets IGA bring real people into its animated world—from employees to local legends.
marketing.partnerships.projects.tfo.deta: TFO has been a cultural cornerstone since 1970. Today it stakes its claim in a market saturated by giants with a modern streaming platform on par with the industry's best.
Through continual refinements, TFO remains an enriching destination for language learners and Francophone audiences across Ontario.
With cable cuts rising and streaming subscriptions growing, TFO seized the opportunity to redefine audience engagement with an ad-free digital universe.
In a six-week sprint, we designed, built and launched a platform with 5,000 content items for Francophones and French learners—across tablets, phones, laptops and consoles.
Closed captioning, transcription, keyboard navigation, and adaptive streaming ensure TFO meets stringent benchmarks for inclusivity and accessibility.
